forecasts.line: Altman says robots able to carry out real-world tasks may arrive in 2027.
forecasts.quote: 2027 may see the arrival of robots that can do tasks

forecasts.line: Andrew Critch puts about forty percent odds on humanity slowly handing Earth over to AGI between 2030 and 2040, most likely via automated industry, ending in human extinction.
Kokotajlo and colleagues expect that by 2027 several tech firms such as Tesla will operate big robot fleets along with factories that make the robots.
forecasts.quote: by 2027 multiple tech companies (e.g. Tesla) have produced large fleets of robots
